messages.text: Hello Inês, is the Printworks Loft still available from December?
It is. The current tenants leave on the 28th, so you could have the keys from the 1st of December.
Perfect. I have booked a viewing.
See you there. The entrance is the green door between the bakery and the bookshop. Ring the top bell and I will come down.
Thank you for coming to see the Garden House. I have passed your offer to the owners.
Thank you. Do you know when they will decide?
They have asked for a couple of days. I will message you the moment I hear.
I am sorry, the owner needs the apartment that afternoon. Would another day suit you?
No problem, I will book another time.
